;Business and economy
*[[Credit Suisse]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Tidjane Thiam]] resigns after a spying scandal. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/07/business/credit-suisse-ceo-resigns/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Batterygate]]
**[[Apple Inc.]] is fined [[Euro|€]]25 million by [[France|French]] [[regulatory agency]] [[DGCCRF|General Directorate of Competition, Consumption & Repression of Frauds]] for deliberately slowing down older [[iPhone]] models. The fine amounts to less than 0.003% of Apple Inc.'s current worth. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-51413724 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Winter Storm Kade]]
**High winds, gusting up to 90 miles per hour, strike [[New England]] as Winter Storm Kade intensifies upon its exit into the Atlantic Ocean.  [https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-02-02-winter-storm-west-rockies-plains-midwest-northeast-early-february (Weather.com)]
**Heavy snowfall blankets much of the north-eastern [[United States]]. More than 1 foot of snowfall is reported widely, with up to 2 feet recorded in parts of [[Maine]] and [[Vermont]].  [https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2020-02-02-winter-storm-west-rockies-plains-midwest-northeast-early-february (Weather.com)]
*Five people are killed in a [[plane crash]] in Western [[Alaska]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/five-dead-commuter-plane-crash-western-alaska-n1132131 (NBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China]]
***[[General Secretary of the Communist Party of China]] [[Xi Jinping]] declares "[[people's war]]" on the [[coronavirus]] pandemic. [https://www.thenational.ae/world/asia/coronavirus-china-declares-people-s-war-on-outbreak-1.975219 (''The National'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health/china-wages-peoples-war-on-coronavirus-as-cruises-companies-hit-idUSKBN20003J (Reuters)]
***[[Li Wenliang]], the doctor who tried to issue the first warnings about the pandemic, dies after contracting the virus. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-51403795 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
***[[Italy]] confirms that an [[Italians|Italian]] man has contracted the virus, after he visited his girlfriend in [[Wuhan]]. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/italia/coronavirus_diretta_italia_italiano_contagiato_quarantena_cecchignola_chi_e_ultime_notizie-5034364.html (''Il Messaggero'')]
**[[Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd.|Royal Caribbean Cruises]] bans [[China]], [[Hong Kong]] or [[Macau]] passport holders from boarding its ships amid concerns over the pandemic. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health-royal-caribbean/royal-caribbean-bans-china-hong-kong-macau-passport-holders-from-ships-on-coronavirus-fears-idUSKBN2012I5 (Reuters)]
*[[Esperanza Base]] on the [[Antarctic Peninsula]] reaches a temperature of {{convert|18.3|C|F}}, the [[List of weather records#Antarctica|hottest on record]] for continental Antarctica. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/07/antarctica-logs-hottest-temperature-on-record-with-a-reading-of-183c (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2020/02/07/antarctica-just-hit-65-degrees-its-warmest-temperature-ever-recorded (''The Washington Post'')]
*It is reported January 2020 was the warmest January ever on record in Europe. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2020/02/03/warmth-is-really-unheard-much-eastern-europe-including-helsinki-moscow-saw-warmest-january-record (''The Washington Post'')] [https://time.com/5779142/global-temperatures-warmest-january (''Time'')]

;International relations
*[[Russia]] repatriates 26 [[Russians|Russian]] children from a [[Syria]]n refugee camp. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russia-repatriates-26-children-syrian-refugee-camp-68820291?cid=clicksource_4380645_2_heads_hero_live_headlines_hed (ABC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Manish Shah (doctor)|Manish Shah]], a [[general practitioner]] in the [[United Kingdom]], is given three [[life sentence]]s at the [[Old Bailey]] for 90 [[sexual assault]]s on 24 of his female patients. [https://bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-51415001 (BBC News)]
*Patrick Crusius, accused of perpetrating the [[2019 El Paso shooting]], is charged with 90 counts of federal [[hate crime]]s. Under the new charges, he could face the [[capital punishment in the United States|death penalty]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-51413425 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] fires [[United States National Security Council|National Security Council]] advisor [[Alexander Vindman|Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman]] and [[United States Ambassador to the European Union|E.U. ambassador]] [[Gordon Sondland]], who both testified as witnesses at the [[impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump|impeachment inquiry]] into him. Vindman's twin brother, Lt. Col. Yevgeny Vindman, an [[Judge Advocate General's Corps, United States Army|Army JAG]] officer also part of the National Security Council staff, is also fired. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/02/07/us/politics/alexander-vindman-gordon-sondland-fired.html (''New York Times'')] [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/02/07/donald-trump-pressure-impeachment-witness-alexander-vindman-111997 (''Politico'')]
